envelope.description: Route scratch-save in the scratch host and wire onScratchSave in extension.ts

body.title: Route scratch-save in the scratch host and wire onScratchSave in extension.ts
body.summary: Add the 'scratch-save' route to createScratchHost.onMessage in scratch-host.ts (validate, await store.updateScratch, reply via panels.replySaved with gen, refresh browse + chat list; ok:false + warn on failure) and wire the document panel's onScratchSave seam in extension.ts to that route; new scratch-host.test.ts plus extension-chat-wiring.test.ts pins.
acceptanceChecks: createScratchHost.onMessage has a 'scratch-save' case validating string id/text + numeric gen (warn+drop otherwise)

on success: await store.updateScratch(id, text) then panels.replySaved(gen, { type:'scratch-saved', id, gen, ok:true }) + refreshBrowse() + scratch-list re-push (sendScratchList) so the menu mtime refreshes
on store failure: replySaved ok:false with error + log.warn, browse/list still refresh
extension.ts wires the new onScratchSave seam to the scratch-host route exactly like onSendToChat (chat-channel SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES interception cannot see document-panel messages)

NEW vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/scratch-host.test.ts covers ok / ok=false / malformed-drop / refresh calls with fake store + fake panels; extension-chat-wiring.test.ts regex-pins the onScratchSave wiring and replySaved

tests.name: scratch-host.test.ts (NEW): 'scratch-save' {id,gen,text} → store.updateScratch called with exact args → replySaved(gen, {type:'scratch-saved', id, gen, ok:true, ...}) posted to the document panel + refreshBrowse + scratch-list re-pushed; store failure → ok:false with error and log.warn; malformed (non-string id/text, non-number gen) dropped with warn

extension-chat-wiring.test.ts regex pins: textarea element, save button, 'scratch-save'/'scratch-saved' strings, replySaved, selectionStart present in the built sources and panel wiring; onScratchSave wiring pinned
